annotations.title: Recently funded startups and who is hiring

description: Startups that announced a funding round or filed an SEC Form D in the last 90 days, from the Work Insiders "Just raised" list: amount, round, date, industry, country, investors, executives named in filings, open roles counted daily on the company's own job board, the change since the raise, sample job titles, hiring signals and a 0-100 recruiter fit score. Filterable by industry, stage, country, recency and hiring.

country.description: Headquarters country, for example "United States", or "europe".

days.description: Rounds announced in the last N days.

hiring_only.description: Only companies with open roles on a public job board now.

query.description: Free text matched against company name, description, job titles and investors. Optional.

name: workinsiders_funded_startups
